caseName: Halifax Tonopah Mining Co. v. Lawson
caseNameFull: Halifax Tonopah Mining Company, in Error v. John W. Lawson
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Nevada.
attorneys: Mr. Henry M. Hoyt, 2d, and Mr. George A. Bartlett for the plaintiff in error., Mr. E. C. Brandenburg, Mr. Clarence A. Brandenburg and Mr. F. Walter Brandenburg for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Chicago, Burlington & Quincy R. R. v. McGuire, 219 U. S. 549; Philadelphia, Baltimore & Washington R. R. v. Schubert, 224 U. S. 603.
